fhparry.name: Parry Prototype
fhparry.desc: Timing-based inputs during enemy attacks. Toggle parry and choose a difficulty preset.
fhparry.enabled.name: Enable Parry
fhparry.enabled.desc: Master switch for the parry helper.
fhparry.audio.name: Play Audio Feedback
fhparry.audio.desc: Play random custom Parry_0x.wav clips on successful parries.
fhparry.ctb.name: Boost Overdrive Gauge
fhparry.ctb.desc: Grant a small Overdrive gain to defenders on a successful parry.
fhparry.logging.name: Debug Logging
fhparry.logging.desc: Write additional parry state changes to the log when enabled.
fhparry.debug_overlay.name: Debug Overlay
fhparry.debug_overlay.desc: Display a live event feed and mapped runtime state panel in-game.
fhparry.difficulty.name: Parry Difficulty
fhparry.difficulty.desc: Select preset parry timing windows and anti-spam behavior (Easy, Normal, Expert, Debug).
fhparry.battle_camera_lock_mode.name: Battle Camera Lock
fhparry.battle_camera_lock_mode.desc: Controls which turns suppress camera movement. Enemy Turns Only (default): camera holds during enemy actions. All Turns: camera holds for everyone. Off: vanilla FFX behavior. Cinematic cameras for boss / summon / overdrive sequences are never blocked.
fhparry.magic_camera_lock.name: Lock Camera During Spells
fhparry.magic_camera_lock.desc: Also hold the camera when an enemy casts a spell. Turn this off if enemy spell effects stop rendering while the Battle Camera Lock is on — spell casts request their camera through a separate engine path.
fhparry.parry_effect.name: Parry Visual Effect
fhparry.parry_effect.desc: Fire a NulShock-style shield flash on the parrying character on a successful parry. Pure visual feedback — no gameplay state effect.
fhparry.streak_counter.name: Streak Counter Attack
fhparry.streak_counter.desc: When a slot completes a defensive streak (every targeted slot in a cue parried at least once and the cumulative streak reaches the threshold), automatically queue a basic Attack from the parrier onto the original attacker. Uses the engine's own auto-counter cue insertion path so CTB scheduling stays consistent.
